schema.expectedIntent: one of: learn_concept | review_critique | debug_fix | decide_choose | generate_create | plan_architect | default
schema.expectedDomain: domain id from detectDomain categories, or null if not applicable to the case
schema.expectedTopicIncludes: substring expected in extractTopic() output, or null
schema.notes: why this case exists / what it guards against

cases.prompt: teach me system deign in a beginner-friendly way
cases.notes: primary target case from spec — sparse input, must still produce full structured archetype

cases.prompt: resume the download after it fails
cases.notes: ADVERSARIAL: resume used as a verb (continue), must NOT trigger resume/hiring persona

cases.prompt: write a script that can resume a paused ffmpeg job
cases.notes: ADVERSARIAL: resume as technical term inside a coding request; domain should be code, not resume/hiring

cases.prompt: let's resume where we left off on the migration plan
cases.notes: ADVERSARIAL: conversational resume, no domain persona should trigger

cases.prompt: can you review my resume, I want to land more interviews
cases.notes: TRUE POSITIVE: explicit review + resume co-occurrence, should trigger hiring persona

cases.prompt: check my resume for a software engineering role
cases.notes: TRUE POSITIVE: check + resume, mentions software engineering but resume intent dominates

cases.prompt: I designed the API to be idempotent and want feedback on the retry logic
cases.notes: ADVERSARIAL: 'designed' used as a verb describing engineering work, not a request for visual design critique

cases.prompt: our system was designed to fail gracefully under load, is this architecture sound?
cases.notes: ADVERSARIAL: 'designed to' negative-gated phrase should not trigger visual design persona

cases.prompt: review my poster design, does the layout work?
cases.notes: TRUE POSITIVE: explicit visual design review request

cases.prompt: she's a great role model for junior engineers on the team
cases.notes: ADVERSARIAL: 'model' as metaphor, must not trigger data science persona

cases.prompt: help me evaluate this classification model's accuracy on the test set
cases.notes: TRUE POSITIVE: ML model evaluation context should trigger data_science

cases.prompt: why isn't my react component re-rendering when state changes
should I use PostgreSQL or MongoDB for a high-write-throughput app
help me design a rate limiter for our public API
